exposure: TeamSTEPPS (Team Strategies and Tools to Enhance Performance and Patient Safety) training
outcome: Incidence and blood loss of postpartum hemorrhage after vaginal delivery (PPH-VD)
Incidence and blood loss of postpartum hemorrhage after cesarean section (PPH-CS)
cohort: The participants were physicians and nurses from a regional perinatal center who were offered TeamSTEPPS instruction.
finding: TeamSTEPPS training as a singular intervention did not significantly improve teamwork and patient safety perceptions or incidences of obstetric emergencies (PPH-VD, PPH-CS, SD), although perceptions significantly differed between physicians and nurses.
mod_finding: The study measured the incidence and blood loss of postpartum hemorrhage after vaginal delivery (PPH-VD) and cesarean section (PPH-CS), finding no significant changes in these outcomes following TeamSTEPPS training.
